conditions: Endpoints of a line segment in a Cartesian plane; coincident endpoints are allowed.
spoken_aliases: m equals the ordered pair with first coordinate the sum of x sub one and x sub two all divided by two and second coordinate the sum of y sub one and y sub two all divided by two

midpoint equals the ordered pair whose first coordinate is the fraction with numerator x sub one plus x sub two and denominator two and whose second coordinate is the fraction with numerator y sub one plus y sub two and denominator two

evidence: For endpoint vectors P and Q, M=P+(Q-P)/2=(P+Q)/2 lies on the segment and is equally distant from the endpoints. Evaluating each coordinate yields the stated ordered pair.

Reference cross-check of the standard relationship: https://openstax.org/books/intermediate-algebra-2e/pages/11-1-distance-and-midpoint-formulas-circles. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
